name: RespSync Visibility Toggle for Elementor
author: Shabab Ahmed

sections.description:
RespSync Visibility Toggle adds a fast, intuitive device visibility toggle button directly inside the Elementor Structure (Navigator) panel item rows.

With a single click, users can check and toggle element visibility across Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile devices without navigating through multiple tab controls in the Elementor settings panel.

Key Features

  • Navigator Panel Integration: Instant access directly on Navigator tree items.
  • Dynamic Multi-Device Status: Visual device icon indicator showing active and hidden states.
  • One-Click Toggle: Show or hide elements across all device breakpoints instantly.
  • Native Synchronization: Seamlessly updates Elementor settings model and marks document as modified for saving.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Pure JavaScript integration with zero overhead on front-end performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the respsync-visibility-toggle-for-elementor directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any page in the Elementor Editor and view the Structure (Navigator) panel.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect site loading speed?

No. The plugin only loads within the Elementor Editor environment and adds zero JavaScript or CSS assets to your public front-end site.

Does it require Elementor Pro?

No, it works seamlessly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.
